node.statement: By validated nodes 1.2.1, 1.2.2, and 1.2.3, the four nonconstant expressions occurring with 1 in (1.6) are finite real numbers: C_theta, C_Delta, C_2, and C_Upsilon are finite, and finite sums and scalar multiples remain finite. Therefore (1.6) defines K as the maximum of five finite real numbers. Hence K is finite; since 1 is one of those five entries, K>=1.
